question: What is the primary global goal of implementing Post-Abortion Care services?

options.A: To increase total fertility rates in developing countries
options.B: To reduce maternal mortality and morbidity from unsafe procedures
options.C: To provide permanent sterilization options for young women
options.D: To replace routine antenatal care in rural health posts

explanation: PAC was specifically designed as a public health model to address the heavy burden of death and severe illness caused by incomplete and unsafe terminations. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h1)

question: Which component is considered one of the five core elements of standard Post-Abortion Care?
explanation: Family planning counseling and service provision before discharge is a mandatory pillar of comprehensive PAC to prevent future unintended pregnancies. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h1)

question: Why is a needs assessment conducted prior to establishing a new PAC service?

options.A: To enforce legal penalties on traditional abortion providers
options.B: To test new experimental surgical devices on patients
options.C: To secure international funding without local government approval
options.D: To determine the local burden of complications and resource needs

explanation: Assessing local health indicators helps administrators plan adequate staffing, drug supplies, and equipment tailored to the community's actual needs. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h2)

question: What is the primary role of community gatekeepers in successful PAC implementation?

options.A: Conducting clinical audits on hospital complication rates
options.B: Performing manual vacuum aspiration procedures at home
options.C: Manufacturing sterile equipment for rural health centers
options.D: Encouraging timely health-seeking behavior for complications

explanation: Involving community leaders helps dismantle stigma, ensuring women with life-threatening complications reach health facilities quickly. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h2)

question: Which instrument set is most commonly required for uterine evacuation during PAC services?
explanation: MVA is the gold standard for safe, effective, and low-cost uterine evacuation in the management of first-trimester incomplete abortions. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h3)

question: A clinic preparing for PAC services must ensure a steady stock of which class of medications to manage postpartum or post-abortion hemorrhage?
explanation: Uterotonics like oxytocin and misoprostol contract the myometrium, effectively controlling bleeding following uterine evacuation. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h3)

question: What is the primary purpose of values clarification workshops in PAC training programs?

options.A: To teach advanced laparoscopic surgical techniques to specialists
options.B: To train administrators in hospital budget management
options.C: To help staff address personal biases and provide non-judgmental care
options.D: To calculate the cost-effectiveness of contraceptive procurement

explanation: Values clarification helps providers separate personal moral beliefs from professional duty, ensuring every patient receives empathetic, respectful treatment. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h4)

question: Why is practical, hands-on clinical practice emphasized over lectures alone in PAC training?

options.A: To build tactile competence and confidence in performing procedures like MVA
options.B: To reduce the financial cost of conducting large seminar workshops
options.C: To comply with international nursing uniform regulations
options.D: To shorten the total duration of preservice nursing education

explanation: Clinical procedures require physical dexterity and real-time decision-making skills that can only be mastered through supervised practice on patients. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h4)

question: What is the immediate clinical priority when managing a patient presenting with severe post-abortion complications?

options.A: Conducting a detailed forensic interrogation about the pregnancy
options.B: Scheduling an elective ultrasound appointment for the following week
options.C: Stabilizing vital signs and treating life-threatening shock or hemorrhage
options.D: Immediate discharge with oral contraceptive pills

explanation: Resuscitation and stabilization of airway, breathing, and circulation always precede any definitive uterine evacuation procedure. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h5)

question: A patient presents with an incomplete abortion accompanied by fever, lower abdominal tenderness, and purulent discharge. What is the appropriate clinical management sequence?

options.A: Delay all uterine procedures until antibiotics are finished for two weeks
options.B: Discharge home with analgesics and advise bed rest only
options.C: Start broad-spectrum antibiotics and perform prompt uterine evacuation
options.D: Perform immediate emergency hysterectomy without medical trial

explanation: Infected products of conception must be removed promptly while covering the patient with appropriate broad-spectrum antibiotics to control sepsis. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h5)

question: When should contraceptive counseling and provision ideally occur during a PAC episode?

options.A: Before the client is discharged from the health facility
options.B: During the next scheduled annual gynecological checkup
options.C: When the patient returns with another unintended pregnancy
options.D: Only after six weeks of mandatory sexual abstinence

explanation: Providing contraception before discharge ensures coverage before fertility returns, as ovulation can resume within two weeks of pregnancy termination. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h6)

question: Which characteristic best defines high-quality PAC family planning counseling?

options.A: Client-centered and offering a full range of voluntary contraceptive options
options.B: Focusing solely on traditional periodic abstinence methods
options.C: Mandating long-acting reversible contraception for all young patients
options.D: Deciding the best contraceptive method on behalf of the client

explanation: Effective counseling respects bodily autonomy by presenting balanced information so clients can freely choose their preferred method. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h6)

question: What is the primary purpose of conducting clinical audits and morbidity reviews in PAC services?

options.A: To inflate hospital revenue statistics for government reports
options.B: To identify systemic gaps and improve the quality of care
options.C: To restrict patient access to emergency surgical theaters
options.D: To penalize individual nurses for medical errors

explanation: Audits are continuous learning tools used to spot procedural bottlenecks, equipment shortages, or training needs to prevent future adverse outcomes. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h7)

question: Which data set is most essential for tracking the operational success of a facility PAC program?

options.A: Frequency of routine building repainting schedules
options.B: Service uptake, complication rates, and contraceptive acceptance
options.C: Number of parking spaces available for emergency visitors
options.D: Total hospital expenditure on administrative staff salaries

explanation: Monitoring clinical metrics like caseloads, complication resolution, and family planning uptake directly reflects service effectiveness and reach. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T020#GNS226_U5_T020_h7)
